verdict.rationale: Zep is a hosted SaaS memory service, so published pricing is a fair question. The only pricing-page evidence (zep-docs-17) mentions deployment options (Cloud, Your VPC) and says nothing about a free tier or per-unit rates. No evidence shows costs can be projected before committing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
